Add powdered mace and chopped nuts
Fill the cake-pans with a layer of the cake, then a layer of raisins upon that, then strew over these a handful of nuts, and so on until the pan is two-thirds full

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream sugar with butter
2. Add eggs, milk, and flour mixed with baking powder
3. Add powdered mace and chopped nuts
4. Fill the cake-pans with a layer of the cake, then a layer of raisins upon that, then strew over these a handful of nuts, and so on until the pan is two-thirds full
5. Line the tins with well-buttered paper
6. Bake in a steady, but not quick, oven
